title: The minimum period of $$\tan(\theta)$$
text: The minimum period of $$\tan(\theta)$$ is pi

title: Relate $$x$$ and $$\theta$$
text: To find the period of $$\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4}x\right), $$ we need to find the range of values for $$x$$ that allows the input to span the same range as $$\tan(\theta)$$ does for $$0<\theta<\pi.$$

title: Substitute
text: Substitute $$\theta$$ with $$\frac{pix}{4}$$ in the standard period interval ( $$0<\theta<2\pi$$ ): \n $$0<\frac{pix}{4}<\pi$$.

title: Solve for the interval of $$x$$
text: Dividing the entire inequality $$0<\frac{pix}{4}<\pi$$ by $$\frac{\pi}{4}$$, we get $$0<x<\operatorname{\pi}\left(\frac{4}{\pi}\right)=4$$. Thus, the period is $$4$$.
